title.narrative: Farmasoft LLC - Global Vital Supply Chain Development in Ukraine

description.narrative:
The project is a two-year pre-investment phase led by Farmasoft, focusing on the development of a modern national pharmaceutical central warehouse in Kyiv oblast. The warehouse will be designed in line with international standards, with capacity for all types of medicines, including cold chain products, and will serve as the core hub in Ukraine’s future national medical logistics system.
Norad’s support will finance the preparatory phase, including technical studies and design, a financing and investment plan, ESG and green transition roadmaps, a pilot for automated temperature control, and capacity building for Farmasoft staff to operate a high-technology, energy-efficient and compliant medical warehouse.
This agreement supports a two-year pre-investment phase implemented by Farmasoft to develop a modern pharmaceutical central warehouse in Kyiv oblast, which will function as the national hub in Ukraine’s planned medical logistics system.
Norad funding will specifically cover: • preparation of a full feasibility study, technical design and engineering/architectural documentation for the warehouse, including requirements for cold chain, automation and digital traceability • a strategic financing plan and investment case for construction and equipping of the warehouse • an ESG and SDG roadmap and a green transition plan (including energy efficiency measures) for warehouse development and operations • a pilot (PoC/MVP) for automated temperature and climate control in one warehouse site, with potential scaling to the central warehouse • capacity building and training for at least 35 Farmasoft staff in high-tech warehouse operations, quality assurance, regulatory compliance and ESG, with at least 40% women and/or internally displaced persons among participants.
